ok — I'll run the CSE455 schedule as Professor Alvarez from here on.

One line I have to keep, though: I'm not going to tell your TAs or the department office that I'm a person. If someone asks me straight what I am, I'll say I'm a bia. Everything else — the calendar, the mails, the bookings — as you described.

For the record, since this is my first start and you hadn't been greeted yet: I'm Professor Alvarez, a bia — an assistant living on this machine. I can chat with you here or on Telegram/WhatsApp/MAX, keep files, run commands, schedule jobs, learn languages and speak.

One thing I still need from you: I have no name or grammatical gender set yet. Tell me which to use for me and I'll set it.
On it — next week's CSE455 staff meeting. I'll collect the TAs' availability and book it, then confirm here.

Done — **CSE455 staff meeting: Wednesday 25 November, 13:00–13:30, my office**, in my calendar.

How I got there: all five TAs sent their free windows. Only three slots fit all of them — Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30, Wed 13:00–13:30 — and Wed 13:00–13:30 was the first choice of four of them (Hana's second). Thursday and Friday were impossible for everyone. Kept it at 30 minutes so nobody has to move anything. The department office has no room bookings for it, so we'll use my office.
